description: Knowledge Map prioritizes legacy 'ClientUI' (client/src) over actual 'FrontendEnhanced' (frontend-enhanced/src). This misleads agents about the active frontend codebase.
recommendation: Rewrite Knowledge Map to mark 'ClientUI' as deprecated/legacy and promote 'FrontendEnhanced' to primary UI node.

description: Orchestrator correctly classifies intents but returns hardcoded mock strings (e.g., 'Ответ от Chef...') instead of invoking agent logic or LLMs.
recommendation: Connect Orchestrator routes to actual LangGraph nodes or prompt chains defined in 'server/graph/nodes/'.

description: QA Gate middleware uses Math.random() for scoring content quality. It fails to implement the AI verification layer described in AGENT_ROUTING_DESIGN.
recommendation: Integrate the 'validateAndCorrectResponse' function (currently dead code) into the middleware flow and connect to OpenAI/Vertex.

description: Upscale functionality targets a non-existent API 'api.nanobanana.com'. This is a placeholder that will always fail or fallback to simulation.
recommendation: Replace 'nanobanana' with a real provider (e.g., Replicate or Stability AI) or explicitly document as a demo mock.

description: Missing critical API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, VERTEX_PROJECT_ID) in .env.example. 'enhanced-media.ts' requires these to function, otherwise it will crash or fail.
recommendation: Update .env.example with required AI provider keys.

description: Function 'validateAndCorrectResponse' in qaGate.ts is fully implemented but never called by the middleware or any other service.
recommendation: Wire up this function to 'qaGateMiddleware' to enable real QA checking.

description: Frontend Enhanced package.json has 'moment' and 'react-big-calendar' which might be heavy if not tree-shaken correctly, checking usage recommended.
recommendation: Review bundle size impact of these libraries.
